summary: The recorded base reproduces the original MiniMax null text_config failure and both prior-review counterexamples. The exact candidate passes its focused regression and independent null-vs-missing boundary cases across get_hf_text_config, Muse Glimmer, ModelOpt FP8, and compressed tensors.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact MiniMax failure and missing-key fallback, plus Muse Glimmer and ModelOpt null-section failures.
Candidate regression and adjacent suites: 80 passed and 2 subtests passed.
Null/missing equivalence, priority fallthrough, input preservation, descriptive ModelOpt errors, and compressed-tensors null handling.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was needed for the deterministic CPU-side configuration parsing contract; the prepared environment is ROCm 7.2 rather than the issue's NVIDIA CUDA environment.

remaining_limitations: The RedHatAI/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-FP8 live-server case was not run because model weights were not supplied.
The prepared host uses ROCm/gfx950, so the reported RTX 4090/CUDA serving environment was not reproduced.
No native source changed; native rebuild validation was not applicable.
